display.purpose: Large page titles on broad dashboard surfaces.

headline.purpose: Selected event identity and primary workspace headings.

body.purpose: Controls, tables, supporting copy, and metadata.

label.purpose: Sparse uppercase kickers and technical labels.

motion.name: ease-continuity
motion.purpose: Default easing for controls, event selection, and the mobile drawer.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default color, border, shadow, opacity, and transform transition.

motion.name: workspace-transition
motion.purpose: Shared event marker, master-detail plane, and mobile drawer movement.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion override; state and controls remain fully available.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action on an operational surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px hsl(var(--primary) / .16); transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .9); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered action for editing and lower-priority commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(36 28 22 / .06); transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .5); background: hsl(var(--muted) / .7); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The canonical dashboard field with a clear orange focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border) / .9); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .45); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(var(--primary)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--primary) / .12); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: A connected operational panel structured by warm rules rather than heavy elevation.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 14px; background: hsl(var(--background) / .45); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(36 28 22 / .06); } .ds-card header { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-body strong { font-size: 30px; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-body span { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .5); }

components.name: Active Rail Item
components.description: The selected destination in the persistent warm-black navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary) / .25); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--primary) / .12); color: white; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-rail-marker { position: absolute; inset-block: 8px; left: 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-rail-icon { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .16); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rail-item { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Selected Event Row
components.description: The anchored master-list selection that keeps the current event visible.
components.css: .ds-event-row { position: relative; display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; align-items: start; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: hsl(var(--primary) / .1); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); text-align: left; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-event-row::before { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; left: 0; width: 4px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); content: ''; } .ds-event-date, .ds-event-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-event-date { text-align: center; } .ds-event-date small, .ds-event-copy small { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 10px; } .ds-event-date strong { font-size: 24px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-event-copy strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-event-copy em { color: hsl(var(--primary)); font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; } .ds-event-row:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .14); } .ds-event-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Workspace Tab
components.description: The active section inside the selected event workspace.
components.css: .ds-workspace-tab { display: inline-flex; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-workspace-tab:hover { color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-workspace-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-workspace-tab { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
EventPass feels like a calm, purpose-built control surface for event operators. Its visual world is warm rather than clinical: Alabaster planes, warm ink, restrained rules, and a single orange voice make dense operational information feel approachable without becoming decorative.

The signature composition is the master-detail Event Workspace. A persistent dark navigation rail establishes product context, an anchored event stack preserves orientation, and the selected event opens into a broad operational plane. Light and dark modes keep the same hierarchy and interaction model; they change tonal values, not structure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, near-monochrome surfaces with Spanish Orange and Royal Orange as the only chromatic accents.
A persistent master-detail workspace that keeps event choice and event operations visible together.
Flat modular panels, crisp dividers, restrained shadows, and consistent 14px panel corners.
Compact, highly legible Inter typography with tight display tracking and tabular operational numbers.
Short spatial transitions that preserve continuity, with a complete reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The One Chromatic Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange owns routine action, selection, progress, and important state; do not introduce blue, green, purple, or multicolor status families.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral should retain a brown-orange undertone in both modes. Dark mode is warm near-black, never slate or navy.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Use flat color only. Gradients are not part of the EventPass dashboard language.

rules.name: The Operational Numeral Rule
rules.body: Counts, dates, percentages, capacities, and timestamps use tabular numerals wherever alignment or comparison matters.

rules.name: The Anchored Context Rule
rules.body: Event selection and event operations belong to one continuous plane. Do not replace the master-detail relationship with a disconnected KPI-card landing page.

rules.name: The Structure-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with fill, border, and layout first. Shadows support interaction or overlays; they do not turn every module into a floating card.

rules.name: The Continuity-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate shared position, selection, progress, and overlays to explain a state change; do not add ambient or ornamental dashboard motion.

dos: Do reserve Spanish Orange for primary actions, selection, progress, focus, and important live state.
Do use warm near-monochrome planes, 14px workspace panels, and one-pixel structural borders.
Do keep the event stack anchored beside event operations when desktop space allows.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, 44px controls, responsive overflow, and the complete reduced-motion override.
Do use tabular numerals for operational metrics and timestamps.
donts: Don't use gradients, cool slate neutrals, or blue-black dark surfaces.
Don't introduce a multicolor semantic status palette; routine states remain neutral or orange.
Don't dissolve the Event Workspace into an interchangeable sidebar-plus-KPI-card dashboard.
Don't overuse shadows, glass blur, pill shapes, or floating containers where borders and tonal layers suffice.
Don't hide core event operations on mobile or make comprehension depend on animation.
